queries.name: marketing_overlap_objects
queries.sql:
SELECT
    s.name AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id
WHERE o.is_ms_shipped = 0
  AND (
       o.name LIKE '%Marketing%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%Campaign%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%Contenido%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%Content%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%Asset%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%Media%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%Atribu%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%Attribution%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%Audiencia%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%Audience%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%Competidor%'
    OR o.name LIKE '%CRM%'
  )
ORDER BY s.name, o.name;

queries.name: canonical_crm_commercial_objects
queries.sql:
SELECT
    s.name AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id
WHERE s.name = 'dbo'
  AND o.name IN (
      'Cliente_Catalogo',
      'Cliente_Contactos',
      'Cliente_Direcciones',
      'CRM_Leads',
      'CRM_Oportunidades',
      'Venta_Cotizaciones',
      'Venta_Pedidos',
      'Comercial_Competidores',
      'Comercial_CompetidoresCatalogo',
      'Comercial_CompetidoresListas',
      'Comercial_CompetidoresListasDetalle',
      'Comercial_CompetidoresMenuItems',
      'Comercial_CompetidoresUnidad',
      'Comercial_Ingesta_Competencia'
  )
ORDER BY o.name;

queries.name: candidate_columns_and_types
queries.sql:
SELECT
    s.name AS schema_name,
    t.name AS table_name,
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS column_name,
    ty.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.precision,
    c.scale,
    c.is_nullable
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.schemas s
  ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns c
  ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types ty
  ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE t.is_ms_shipped = 0
  AND (
       t.name LIKE '%Marketing%'
    OR t.name LIKE '%Campaign%'
    OR t.name LIKE '%Content%'
    OR t.name LIKE '%Asset%'
    OR t.name LIKE '%Media%'
    OR t.name LIKE '%Competidor%'
    OR t.name LIKE 'CRM_%'
    OR t.name LIKE 'Cliente_%'
  )
ORDER BY s.name, t.name, c.column_id;

queries.name: candidate_foreign_keys
queries.sql:
SELECT
    sch1.name AS parent_schema,
    t1.name AS parent_table,
    c1.name AS parent_column,
    fk.name AS fk_name,
    sch2.name AS referenced_schema,
    t2.name AS referenced_table,
    c2.name AS referenced_column
FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc
JOIN sys.foreign_keys fk
  ON fk.object_id = fkc.constraint_object_id
JOIN sys.tables t1
  ON t1.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id
JOIN sys.schemas sch1
  ON sch1.schema_id = t1.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns c1
  ON c1.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id
 AND c1.column_id = fkc.parent_column_id
JOIN sys.tables t2
  ON t2.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id
JOIN sys.schemas sch2
  ON sch2.schema_id = t2.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns c2
  ON c2.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id
 AND c2.column_id = fkc.referenced_column_id
WHERE
       t1.name LIKE '%Marketing%'
    OR t1.name LIKE '%Campaign%'
    OR t1.name LIKE '%Content%'
    OR t1.name LIKE '%Asset%'
    OR t1.name LIKE '%Media%'
    OR t1.name LIKE '%Competidor%'
    OR t1.name LIKE 'CRM_%'
    OR t2.name LIKE '%Marketing%'
    OR t2.name LIKE '%Campaign%'
    OR t2.name LIKE '%Content%'
    OR t2.name LIKE '%Asset%'
    OR t2.name LIKE '%Media%'
    OR t2.name LIKE '%Competidor%'
    OR t2.name LIKE 'CRM_%'
ORDER BY parent_schema, parent_table, fk_name;

queries.name: company_unit_scope_candidates
queries.sql:
SELECT
    s.name AS schema_name,
    t.name AS table_name,
    c.name AS column_name,
    ty.name AS data_type
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.schemas s
  ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns c
  ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types ty
  ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE c.name IN (
    'empresa_id',
    'EmpresaID',
    'id_empresa',
    'unidad_negocio_id',
    'unidad_negocio_pk',
    'sucursal_id',
    'SucursalID',
    'fecha_operacion',
    'FechaOperacion'
)
AND (
       t.name LIKE '%Marketing%'
    OR t.name LIKE '%Campaign%'
    OR t.name LIKE '%Content%'
    OR t.name LIKE '%Competidor%'
    OR t.name LIKE 'CRM_%'
    OR t.name LIKE 'Cliente_%'
    OR t.name LIKE 'Venta_%'
)
ORDER BY s.name, t.name, c.column_id;
